en-US.longDescription: BeanDesk is a local-first double-entry bookkeeping desktop application. It requires no cloud accounts or external databases - your ledger and supporting documents stay entirely on your own machine. Powered by AI agents for automated recording and compliance checks, it generates standardized financial statements with multi-destination encrypted backups.
en-US.name: BeanDesk
en-US.releaseNotes:
更新内容 / What's Changed
- 入账前双轨查重与单批预览：写入科目、凭证或月度分录前，先检索编号匹配（^inv-<完整号码> / ^ct-<完整合同号>）与 7 天同金额业务指纹，并输出单张汇总确认清单（#72）
- 凭证归档文件名规范：含法定或合同唯一编号的原始凭证，文件名统一为 YYYY-MM-DD.inv-<完整号码>.说明.扩展名 或 YYYY-MM-DD.ct-<完整合同号>.说明.扩展名（#72）
- 账套结构升至 v3：既有账套执行“升级账套结构”（upgrade_ledger）时自动刷新 policies/base/ 系统基线引导词，保留记账分录与企业自订制度（#74）

- Pre-posting dual-track dedup & batch preview: check ID matches (^inv-<full-number> / ^ct-<full-contract>) and 7-day same-amount fingerprints with a single confirmation summary before writing accounts, documents, or postings (#72)
- Document filing naming: source documents with a statutory or contract ID use YYYY-MM-DD.inv-<full-number>.note.ext or YYYY-MM-DD.ct-<full-contract>.note.ext (#72)
- Ledger skeleton v3: upgrading an existing ledger (upgrade_ledger) now refreshes policies/base/ baseline guides in place while preserving postings and custom policies (#74)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/SuperDaniel-cn/BeanDesk/compare/v0.2.7...v0.2.9

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的复式记账桌面软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: BeanDesk 是一款运行在本地的复式记账桌面软件。不设云端账号，无需自建数据库，账目与原始凭证完全由自己保管。可结合 AI 协助日常录账与合规核查，即时生成规范的对公财务报表，并提供本地与远端加密备份。
